items.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did run across Red Callendar.

ctx.x: I did, but I don’t remember him doing that show. But I did run across Red Callendar.

Before we digress to talking about Los Angeles again, we were still talking about the ’70s, and you were trying to explain why there was – seemed to be a schism or break with the tradition at that point. You were talking about fusion and Miles and the modal thing. But somehow you were saying that it took you a while to get a grasp of the modal thing?
